description: <p>President Volodymyr Zelensky on Monday said Ukraine was behind strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya, adding that one of them sank in the latest spillover from Moscow’s war with Kyiv.</p> <p>The attacks on Sunday near the Libyan port of Benghazi come at a time when Ukraine has stepped up its strikes against Russia far from the frontlines.</p> <p>But the United Nations condemned the strikes, warning against the prospect of a country still divided after the Libyan civil war becoming “a battleground for foreign conflicts”.</p> <p>“It all took place

headline: Rice exports up by 0.35m tonnes in four months
description: <p>LAHORE: Pakistan’s total rice exports surged by 353,000 tonnes to reach 1,351,000 tonnes during the first four months (July-October) of the current fiscal year 2026-27.</p> <p>The exports were propelled by a massive 62pc jump in Basmati shipments that defied severe maritime disruptions across the Red Sea, the Strait of Hormuz, and the broader Middle East.</p> <p>According to trade figures for the July-Oct 2026 period, Basmati exports climbed by 116,000 tonnes compared to the corresponding period last year to stand at 301,000 tonnes. headline: ‘Global food import bill up 1.9pc in 2026’
description: <p>ISLAMABAD: Global expenditure on food imports is expected to increase moderately in 2026, with the global food import bill projected to reach $2,267 billion, up 1.9 per cent from the revised estimate of $2,224.8 billion, according to a new United Nations report.</p> <p>According to the Food Outlook published by the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), import bills are expected to rise for most food groups in 2026, led by animal products and the oil seed complex, while cereals are also projected to record an increase.</p> <p>Prospects for the remainder of 20

headline: Varma century in vain as Pakistan Shaheens down India A in Asia Cup Rising Stars clash
description: <p>Pakistan Shaheens overcame a late challenge from Tilak Varma to beat India A by 48 runs in their Asia Cup Rising Stars match in Doha on Sunday, defending a total of 313 after bowling out their opponents with five balls to spare.</p> <p>Skipper Varma struck a century before becoming the last man dismissed for 100 off 149 balls, while Shahbaz Ahmed made 56 in a seventh-wicket stand that briefly revived India’s hopes.</p> <p>But Pakistan’s bowlers held their nerve in the closing overs, with Hasan Nawaz claiming three wickets and Ali Raza taking three for 56.</p
